name: Bit output
description: Sends whether the pin's voltage is above the threshold to the external program

parameters.name: address
parameters.label: Address
parameters.description: Name of the signal in the external program, sent exactly as written (%IX0.10, %QW2)

parameters.name: polarity
parameters.label: Polarity
parameters.description: Inverted: true outside is a low level in the circuit

parameters.name: Vth
parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.description: A voltage above it is a true bit
